# Sky Hopper

Sky Hopper is a small, original side-scrolling platformer example for `1.2.1/lgt-raptor/aram-wie-raptor`. It uses only code-drawn rectangles, arcs, lines, and text; it contains no characters, maps, images, sounds, or names from an existing commercial game.
